Step 2: Click login button

tests.requirement: User can browse available courses
tests.title: Course browsing test
tests.steps:
Step 1: Access course list
Step 2: Verify available courses are displayed

tests.requirement: User can search for courses
tests.title: Course search test
tests.steps:
Step 1: Enter valid search query
Step 2: Click search button
Step 3: Verify search results

tests.requirement: Search returns no results for invalid query
tests.title: Invalid course search test
tests.steps:
Step 1: Enter invalid search query
Step 2: Click search button
Step 3: Verify no results are displayed
tests.expected_result: System returns no search results for invalid query

tests.requirement: User can enroll in course
tests.title: Course enrollment test
tests.steps:
Step 1: Access course details
Step 2: Click enroll button
Step 3: Verify user is enrolled
tests.expected_result: System enrolls user in course successfully

tests.requirement: System prevents double enrollment
tests.title: Double enrollment test
tests.preconditions: User is already enrolled in course
tests.steps:
Step 1: Attempt to enroll again
Step 2: Verify system prevents double enrollment
tests.expected_result: System prevents user from enrolling twice

tests.requirement: User can open enrolled course
tests.title: Course access test
tests.steps:
Step 1: Access course materials
Step 2: Verify user has access to course
tests.expected_result: System allows user to access enrolled course

tests.requirement: User can view assignment list
tests.title: Assignment list test
tests.steps:
Step 1: Access course materials
Step 2: Verify assignment list is displayed

tests.requirement: Access restrictions for non-enrolled users
tests.title: Non-enrolled user access test
tests.preconditions: User is not enrolled in course
tests.steps:
Step 1: Attempt to access course materials
Step 2: Verify system restricts access
tests.expected_result: System prevents non-enrolled users from accessing course

tests.requirement: Session timeout handling
tests.title: Session timeout test
tests.steps:
Step 1: Simulate session timeout
